Name: Seasonal Silo adjustable hay capacity
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Optional changes Silo color to seasonal color. Spring is yellow. Summer is pink. Fall is orange and Winter is blue.
Optional Hay capacity.



[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract [b]Silo to Seasonal Silo[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
